meta.name: lint-fixer
meta.description: Mandatory post-implementation lint and type-checking skill that runs after ANY code change, bug fix, new feature, refactor, API change, or configuration modification. Ensures all ruff lint errors, mypy type errors, and ESLint issues are resolved. Use after every implementation that modifies source files. Use when code has been edited. Use for every response where file edits were made.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 修复代码改动后的静态检查与类型错误
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你写完代码常被 lint 和类型报错困扰
copy.tagline_en: Fix lint and type errors after any code change
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you constantly fix lint and type errors manually

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在每次改完代码后自动运行 lint 和类型检查,修复 ruff、mypy、ESLint 报错,补充类型注解、整理导入,并重复检查直到全部通过。
howto.when: 每次你让 Claude 修改代码、修 bug 或加功能后,它完成改动就会自动运行检查。

say.text: 改完这段代码后,运行 ruff 和 mypy 检查并修复所有报错。
say.note: Claude 会执行 lint 和类型检查并自动修复。

say.text: 帮我修一下这个函数的类型错误,然后整理一下导入。
重构这个模块,确保通过 ruff 和 mypy 检查。
say.note: 改动后会自动验证并修复。

howto.what_en: After editing code, Claude automatically runs ruff and mypy checks, fixes lint and type errors, adds type annotations, organizes imports, and repeats until all checks pass.
howto.when_en: Triggers automatically after any code change, bug fix, new feature, refactor, or configuration modification that edits files.

say_en.text: After changing this code, run ruff and mypy and fix all errors.
say_en.note: Claude will run the checks and fix issues.

say_en.text: Fix the type errors in this function and organize the imports.
Refactor this module and make sure ruff and mypy pass.
